## Execution ledger — 2026-10-19 — inventory and verification complete; dispatch blocked

This is a current-state coordination receipt from the requested issue-to-merge execution. It is not an Opus review or a claim that the original primary's runtime/merge lock has been transferred.

### Source of truth and ownership

Current `main`: **`2dd687f858549ee8eeb9c98f83344814dfc7d0b6`**, re-read immediately before this receipt. Current GitHub pagination found **172 issues: 66 open / 106 closed**, and **126 PRs: 120 merged / 6 closed without merge / 0 open**. The combined issue collection was read in pages of 100, 100 and 98; PRs in pages of 100 and 26; the open-issue second page was empty. All **173 existing #80 comment bodies** were read. Open-issue bodies, discussions, dependencies, milestones and existing acceptance receipts were reconciled; a detailed continuation table follows separately.

Read the current CONTRIBUTING contract, orchestration prompt, development/merge-readiness/notebook-CI guides, all four workflows, PR and issue templates, and catalog. No applicable AGENTS.md was present in the fetched repository or local parent paths.

The [last completed-run receipt](https://github.com/Jev-Engineering/cookbook/issues/80#issuecomment-6187157003) retains dispatch and serial-merge ownership with the same primary; the [later #213 correction](https://github.com/Jev-Engineering/cookbook/issues/80#issuecomment-6189282972) retains its status and implementation ownership. [The standing model decision](https://github.com/Jev-Engineering/cookbook/issues/80#issuecomment-6070170893) permits Sonnet 5 / Opus 5 for that existing run and expressly provides no other model substitution or new controller. Current activity of that other runtime is **unverified**, not asserted active or absent. No ownership transfer was found.

**Execution blockers:** this session exposes no callable, verified Claude Sonnet builder/integration worker or Claude Opus reviewer. The repository also prohibits the orchestrator from implementing code. The available internal assistants were used only for read-only orchestration evidence; they were not designated builders or qualifying reviewers. No paid coding service was invoked. Existing branches and issue states are preserved.

### Verified main and local checks

All **59 actual CheckRuns** on this exact main SHA are `completed/success`, all from `github-actions`, with 59 distinct names. `filter=all` also returned 59 successful rows; no superseded failed/cancelled attempts were concealed. There are **zero StatusContexts**. The empty combined-status endpoint's aggregate `pending` therefore is not a pending named required check.

| Evidence | Observed result |
| --- | --- |
| [CI run 39184562198](https://github.com/Jev-Engineering/cookbook/actions/runs/39184562198) | Lint, catalog, Python 3.10 tests and Python 3.14 tests successful |
| [Python 3.10 job](https://github.com/Jev-Engineering/cookbook/actions/runs/39184562198/job/117844125441) | Log: 4,919 passed, 46 skipped, 50 deselected, 31 xfailed |

| Local `python tools/render_catalog.py --check` | Exit 0; generated README is current |

| Local `env -u TYPESAFE_API_KEY JEV_COOKBOOK_LIVE=0 PYTHONPATH=src python tools/notebook_ci.py fixtures` | Exit 0; 51 folders, 0 failed |

These local checks ran on Python 3.12.14. The full test suites and notebook executions above are **GitHub CI evidence**, not claimed as fresh local executions or independent Opus review. Existing skips, deselections and xfails remain disclosed; green CI does not discharge their owning issues.

No PR is open, so there is no eligible head to pass to the merge-readiness helper. The helper was not run and no READY receipt or merge authorization is asserted. Scope remains a required PR-head check, not a main check.

### Current acceptance and continuation findings

- **#213 remains incomplete despite its closed state.** Newer merged #298 adds actual-call accounting support and an opt-in audit. Credit that delivery: the older ledger predates it. No published notebook or template currently uses `AuditedBackend`; the full corpus audit, duplicate-decision rule, shared declaration and reconciled live accounting remain outstanding. Primary should reconcile/reopen the issue with #298 credited before any recording.
- **#262 has existing completion evidence.** #293/#294 are merged; the exact-current-main scan finds zero case-insensitive `build note` occurrences across 307 tracked recipe .py/.md/notebook-source files. Original scope only: this does not prove every private-pointer spelling is gone. Primary closure remains pending; #225/#163 retain their broader work.
- **#283 has only its #53/#56 issue-body amendments left.** #292 delivered the author-facing guidance and a reasoned enforcement decision. Exact proposed additive wording is being recorded on #283 for primary application and readback before builder dispatch.
- **#249 needs acceptance/provenance reconciliation, not a duplicate #280 implementation.** Its final recorded review marks the four written criteria met, including the explicitly permitted documented deferral. The receipt alone lacks an explicit native reviewer ID/model declaration; recover the original primary's authentication evidence before certifying closure.
- **#276 precedes broad #244 repairs.** #244's guard exists; its remaining 31 strict-xfail objective-pin entries are genuine recipe debt, not a missing shared implementation.
- **#240 already has a shared ranking helper via #185.** Remaining recipe-17 migration, caveats and corpus audit should reuse it.
- #228, #227, #257, #267, #284 and #290 have substantive decisions already recorded in their discussions. Future briefs must preserve those corrections instead of asking the same policy questions or implementing the opening suggestion blindly.

### Publication, branches and live evidence

The current catalog has **100 entries**: **50/60 original recipes published**, **0/40 multimodal recipes published**. Ranks 61–100 all have `issue: null`; they are not issues #61–#100 and cannot authorize recipe PRs until real assignments reach the trusted base catalog.

GitHub has **45 branches including main**. The 44 retained branches comprise four foundation branches, recipe 44 and 39 multimodal recipe branches. Of those multimodal branches, 23 contain their own notebook. They have no active PR. They are preserved; ahead/behind counts alone do not establish unfinished implementation because #296/#297/#298 delivered squash merges from related work. Closed duplicate PR #291 is not reopened.

A current scan of all 52 `responses*.json` files found **3,584 answer-provenance records, all synthetic**; recipe 36 uses scripted fixtures. No committed authentic recording coverage is established. There were **0 new live calls, $0 new provider spend and 0 new reservations in this execution**. The original **$25 cumulative** authorization is unchanged; historic smoke usage, actual charges, uncertain outcomes and outstanding reservations still need reconciliation. No usable remaining balance is asserted, and no credential search was performed.

### Exact continuation point

Resume with the recorded primary, or an explicit ownership handoff, in a runtime that can verify the required builder and reviewer models. First finish the primary-owned acceptance/status corrections above, then prioritize request accounting and safety/CI prerequisites before guard/sweep work and recipes #51/#52. #60 still waits on #59; the advanced/expert audits, Linux and Windows release validation, authentic evidence, reviewed release preparation and separate human tag/release approval remain outstanding.

**This execution: 0 code commits, 0 pushes, 0 PRs opened, 0 PRs merged, 0 issues closed/reopened.** Current main and local checkout remain unchanged and clean. This is a durable continuation receipt, not a claim of continuous background operation or repository completion.
